title: Vibrato and palm mute
description: The two boolean techniques: a half-note D4 (string 2) with vibrato, then two palm-muted quarter-note chugs on the open low E. Both are flags rather than structured objects because they carry no parameters — vibrato depth and mute intensity are performance, not notation. Palm mute is arguably a span (like ottava) rather than a per-note flag; that open question is recorded in docs/mnx-extensions.md, and this scenario exercises the per-note form v5 actually has. The renderer does not draw either mark yet; the goldens pin the annotated notes rendering cleanly on both staves.
